brief:
Knesset speaker Matan Kahana accused Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of deliberately obstructing the formation of an Eisenkot-led government, Shehab Wire reported. Kahana said Netanyahu was using delaying tactics to push for new elections instead of allowing the government formation process to proceed.

The accusation came amid reported secret negotiations between Netanyahu and Naftali Bennett, as well as separate moves by Bennett toward the Eisenkot bloc, adding complexity to Israel's ongoing political crisis.

title: Knesset speaker accuses Netanyahu of stalling to block Eisenkot government
